verdict.rationale: Entra ID's own docs describe an application gallery of pre-integrated SAML/OIDC apps for SSO, which vendors can request to join (docs-15). They also cover managing integrated cloud apps right away (docs-25) and SaaS integrations such as Dropbox, Salesforce and ServiceNow, though that mention is about provisioning (docs-3). The evidence does not show the catalog's size or how fast setup is. Missing for 10: evidence the gallery holds thousands of SAML/OIDC integrations, evidence that setup takes minutes rather than custom work, independent or hands-on corroboration of catalog coverage.
